notes.title: The Free Demo for "Rhythm Animal Café" Is Now Available on Steam!​
notes.notes: [p]The free demo for ​[b]​"Rhythm Animal Café"​[/b]​ is now live on Steam! Everyone is welcome to download and play it immediately, offering an early taste of this little café hidden at a street corner, filled with rhythm and laughter.[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3979510/Rhythm_Animal_Caf_Demo/"]The Free Demo for "Rhythm Animal Café"[/url][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🎵 ​[b]Demo Experience[/b]​[/h3][p align="start"]This demo features two playable characters and their exciting daily lives:[/p][list][*][p][b]🐶 Mr. Dog[/b]​[/p][p]A diligent white-collar worker in Animal Town. This demo includes ​[b]3 workplace-themed mini-levels[/b]. Are you ready to face the "boss's big promises"? See if these relatable "corporate working-dog" moments make you smile or nod in agreement![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45703691/15a312d9914ffc0c9e2e3d7151c69ccedc0c74c5.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]🐼 Panda Master[/b]​[/p][p]A "side hustler" who helps neighbors with repairs during the day and runs a fried noodle stall at night. The demo includes ​[b]1 mini-level[/b]​ for Panda Master. Though an ordinary citizen, he holds big dreams in his heart.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45703691/58102249487df6921f5ceaa6b667e8ce5128d278.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]Through the demo, you’ll experience the game’s core intuitive rhythm gameplay—no complex button prompts needed! Just follow the music rhythm and scene cues, tap along, and effortlessly immerse yourself in this stress-relieving and joyful experience.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🚀 ​[b]Standalone Demo Page[/b]​[/h3][p align="start"]This demo has its ​[b]own standalone Steam store page[/b]​! You can leave your feedback directly on the demo page. If you have any ideas or suggestions, we encourage you to share them openly—your input is incredibly valuable to us.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🌟 ​[b]Future Full Version[/b]​[/h3][p align="start"]The full version is planned to include ​[b]5 characters and 35 levels[/b]​ in total! Each character will have their own unique profession and storyline, waiting for everyone to explore and experience.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]❤️ ​[b]Your Support Matters[/b]​[/h3][p align="start"]If you enjoy the demo, we kindly ask you to:[/p][p][b]1. Add "Rhythm Animal Café" to your Steam wishlist!​[/b]​ ✨[/p][p][b]2. Leave your valuable feedback on the demo store page!​[/b]​ 📝[/p][p][b]3. Share this discovery with friends!​[/b]​ 🎮[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🎵 ​[b]About "Rhythm Animal Café"​[/b]​[/h3][p align="start"]"Rhythm Animal Café" is an intuitive rhythm music game developed by ​[b]Salt Game Studio[/b]. We aim to provide players with a carefree, relaxing, and joyful experience through a lighthearted atmosphere, simple controls, and catchy rhythms.[/p][p align="start"]Thank you all once again for your attention and support! We look forward to meeting you in "Rhythm Animal Café"—let’s follow the rhythm together and enjoy little moments of delight in our busy lives![/p]

notes.title: Demo for Rhythm Animal Café Delayed Slightly
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]We've got a quick update to share about the Steam Demo for Rhythm Animal Café.[/p][p][/p][p]The demo was originally planned for August 30, but we've run into a few last-minute technical hiccups. Rather than rushing it out, we are taking a bit more time to smooth things over so your first experience with the game feels as fun (and polished) as it should.[/p][p][/p][p]The team is already hard at work on fixes, and we'll get the demo into your hands as soon as possible. In the meantime, adding Rhythm Animal Café to your Steam Wishlist is the best way to get notified the moment it's ready, it really helps us out too.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45703691/92cc59f6310e0c16cce4aaac89204f651855606e.gif"][/img][/p][p]We're sorry to keep you waiting, and we know how excited many of you are to give it a try. Thank you so much for your patience and support, it really means the world to us. We can't wait to share the demo with you very soon.[/p]
